The disabled 'Open' buttons (dev-madrid and Offline fixture) have low-contrast text. They can still be read, but they're faint against the dark background.
The secondary hint text ('Coming later.', the SSH tunnel note) is small and muted gray, so contrast is low but it's still readable.
